NewsArticle.Title: System Maintenance
NewsArticle.Content: A sudden flood of greenish skeletal warriors has been invading the various towns and villages of Temuair. Although weak at the moment, it is feared by the Druid Coibhi that more powerful entities are on their way. Eduardo, Burgess of Rucesion, has talked with the Rangers about the possibility that Aislings are allying themselves with the spirit, Chadul, in an attempt to bring his chaos into the realm.
